independent_scope_check.conclusion: Retain No Issue Found within the inspected core scope, with zero Major, zero Minor and one unresolved ancillary scope question. The division-ring injection argument does not assume flatness; the tree argument proves the kernel quotient free before nonzero coefficients detect its abelianization; the torsion step distinguishes regular coinvariants from arbitrary modules and uses invertibility of the finite order. General total-order staggering versus the displayed integer-indexed infinite proof remains Needs Evidence, with no counterexample established.
